description: A database seeding script for a sports telecast backend, responsible for populating initial sample data such as users, teams, events, matches, emojis, highlights, match events, and reactions into the database for development and testing purposes.

methods.name: generate_uuid_mappings
methods.description: Generates UUID mappings for all entities to ensure consistent UUID usage across seeding functions.

methods.name: seed_database
methods.description: Coordinates the seeding process by calling individual seed functions for emojis, teams, events, matches, users, match events, highlights, and reactions.

methods.name: seed_emojis
methods.description: Seeds emoji assets into the database using provided UUID mappings.

methods.name: seed_teams
methods.description: Seeds team data into the database using provided UUID mappings.

methods.name: seed_events
methods.description: Seeds event data into the database using provided UUID mappings.

methods.name: seed_matches
methods.description: Seeds match data into the database using provided UUID mappings.

methods.name: seed_users
methods.description: Seeds user data into the database using provided UUID mappings.

methods.name: seed_match_events
methods.description: Seeds match event data (goals, cards, substitutions) into the database using provided UUID mappings.
